Hi Claire — great to speak today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call: 

Key takeaways:
- Primary goal: embed low-latency text-generation for customer support triage (target p95 < 200ms).
- Data sensitivity: PII redaction required; potential SOC 2 + contractual controls.
- Deployment preference: start on Redwood Hosted, evaluate Private (VPC) for regulated flows.
- Cost sensitivity: target ~20% lower per-token cost vs current self-hosted baseline.

Next steps I propose:
1) Technical deep-dive + architecture review (1 hour) — we'll demo runtime, routing, and quantization tradeoffs.
2) Security/procurement sync to confirm evidence & standard terms.

Proposed 1-hour demo slots (all PT):
- Wed Feb 18 — 10:00–11:00am PT
- Thu Feb 19 — 1:00–2:00pm PT

Can you confirm which works, and please loop in the folks from Security and Procurement who should join? I CC'd Laura (SE) to help run the demo and capture the architecture notes. If those slots don't work we can propose alternatives early next week.

Relevant prep: demo checklist and sample network diagram (drive link below) — will share more artifacts once we lock a time.
